calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, cp.subcategory, cp.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT subcategory, category, SUM(quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_distinct_rl, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1
FROM lines GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS ctl_units, COUNT(*) AS ctl_days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT s.subcategory, s.units_sold, COALESCE(r.units_returned,0) AS units_returned, (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM sold) AS my_total, c.ctl_units, c.ctl_days
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (subcategory), ctl c ORDER BY s.units_sold DESC LIMIT 6

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory AS as_is_subcat, p.subcategory AS as_was_subcat, SUM(f.quantity) AS units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.subcategory IS DISTINCT FROM p.subcategory
GROUP BY 1,2
